viewdef:
WITH base AS (
         SELECT e.id,
            e.user_id,
            e.anon_id,
            e.session_id,
            e.event,
            e.props,
            e.sport,
            e.source,
            e.path,
            e.created_at,
            NULLIF(e.props ->> 'stripe_checkout_session_id'::text, ''::text) AS _sid,
            COALESCE(e.props ->> 'purpose'::text, ''::text) AS _purpose
           FROM product_events e
          WHERE e.event = 'checkout_completed'::text
        ), with_sid AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (base._sid) base.id,
            base.user_id,
            base.anon_id,
            base.session_id,
            base.event,
            base.props,
            base.sport,
            base.source,
            base.path,
            base.created_at
           FROM base
          WHERE base._sid IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY base._sid, base.created_at DESC
        ), no_sid_flagged AS (
         SELECT b.id,
            b.user_id,
            b.anon_id,
            b.session_id,
            b.event,
            b.props,
            b.sport,
            b.source,
            b.path,
            b.created_at,
            b._sid,
            b._purpose,
                CASE
                    WHEN lag(b.created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY b.user_id, b._purpose ORDER BY b.created_at) IS NULL OR (b.created_at - lag(b.created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY b.user_id, b._purpose ORDER BY b.created_at)) > '02:00:00'::interval THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END AS _new_grp
           FROM base b
          WHERE b._sid IS NULL
        ), no_sid_grouped AS (
         SELECT f.id,
            f.user_id,
            f.anon_id,
            f.session_id,
            f.event,
            f.props,
            f.sport,
            f.source,
            f.path,
            f.created_at,
            f._sid,
            f._purpose,
            f._new_grp,
            sum(f._new_grp) OVER (PARTITION BY f.user_id, f._purpose ORDER BY f.created_at) AS _grp
           FROM no_sid_flagged f
        ), no_sid AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (no_sid_grouped.user_id, no_sid_grouped._purpose, no_sid_grouped._grp) no_sid_grouped.id,
            no_sid_grouped.user_id,
            no_sid_grouped.anon_id,
            no_sid_grouped.session_id,
            no_sid_grouped.event,
            no_sid_grouped.props,
            no_sid_grouped.sport,
            no_sid_grouped.source,
            no_sid_grouped.path,
            no_sid_grouped.created_at
           FROM no_sid_grouped
          ORDER BY no_sid_grouped.user_id, no_sid_grouped._purpose, no_sid_grouped._grp, no_sid_grouped.created_at DESC
        )
 SELECT with_sid.id,
    with_sid.user_id,
    with_sid.anon_id,
    with_sid.session_id,
    with_sid.event,
    with_sid.props,
    with_sid.sport,
    with_sid.source,
    with_sid.path,
    with_sid.created_at
   FROM with_sid
UNION ALL
 SELECT no_sid.id,
    no_sid.user_id,
    no_sid.anon_id,
    no_sid.session_id,
    no_sid.event,
    no_sid.props,
    no_sid.sport,
    no_sid.source,
    no_sid.path,
    no_sid.created_at
   FROM no_sid;
